title: Metastatic melanoma on immune checkpoint blockade
abstract: Patients with stage IV melanoma treated with anti-PD-1 alone (pembrolizumab or nivolumab) or combined with ipilimumab, at Melanoma Institute Australia and other centres: 75 patients with treatment, best response, tumour neoantigen counts and overall survival.
origin: Melanoma Institute Australia and The University of Sydney

title: Maternal health risk assessment, Kurigram
abstract: Clinical records of 1,205 pregnant women seen at Kurigram General Hospital, a district hospital in rural northern Bangladesh: age, blood pressure, blood sugar, body temperature, body mass index, heart rate, medical history and a pregnancy risk level (low or high).
origin: Daffodil International University and Kurigram General Hospital

title: German Breast Cancer Study Group trial 2 (GBSG-2)
abstract: Patient records from the GBSG-2 randomised 2x2 trial of hormonal treatment and chemotherapy duration in node-positive breast cancer in Germany: tumour and patient characteristics with recurrence-free survival time.

title: Copenhagen Stroke Study
abstract: Patients admitted with acute stroke to Bispebjerg Hospital, Copenhagen, in the Copenhagen Stroke Study: 518 patients with cardiovascular risk factors, stroke subtype, Scandinavian Stroke Scale score at admission and long-term survival.

title: PAQUID cohort on brain ageing, sample of 2,561
abstract: A sample of 2,561 people aged 65 and over from PAQUID, a prospective cohort on functional and cerebral ageing started in 1988 in Gironde and Dordogne, south-western France: two cognitive test scores at baseline and time to dementia or to death without dementia over up to 12 years.
origin: PAQUID study group, Inserm and University of Bordeaux

title: MRC streptomycin trial for pulmonary tuberculosis
abstract: The Medical Research Council trial of streptomycin plus bed rest versus bed rest alone in 107 young adults with acute progressive pulmonary tuberculosis, published in 1948 and widely seen as the first modern randomised controlled trial. Patient-level records reconstructed from the published report.
origin_country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
origin: Medical Research Council, Streptomycin in Tuberculosis Trials Committee
coverage: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

title: Colorectal cancer cohort, Hassan II University Hospital, Fez
abstract: Retrospective cohort of 346 patients with colorectal cancer diagnosed and followed at Hassan II University Hospital, Fez, Morocco, between 2009 and 2015: sociodemographic, tumour, molecular and treatment characteristics, delay to start of treatment, and overall survival over 36 months from diagnosis.
origin: Hassan II University Hospital and Sidi Mohamed Ben Abdellah University, Fez

title: Morocco Global Youth Tobacco Survey, student records
abstract: Student-level records from the Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS) in Morocco: tobacco and e-cigarette use, exposure to second-hand smoke, media and school messages, and family background, with survey weight, stratum and primary sampling unit for design-based analysis.
origin: World Health Organization and US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, with the Ministry of Health of Morocco

title: Morocco health system resources by province, 2003-2024
abstract: Primary care facilities, public hospital beds and hospital activity for every Moroccan province and prefecture from 2003 to 2024, extracted from all 22 editions of the Ministry of Health yearly report Santé en Chiffres, harmonised to current province codes and checked against every national total printed in the reports.
origin: Ministère de la Santé et de la Protection Sociale, Kingdom of Morocco

title: Morocco province health panels, 2019-2024
abstract: Notifiable disease cases, public and private health workforce, and target populations for every Moroccan province and prefecture, 2019-2024, extracted from the Ministry of Health annual reports and checked against their printed totals.
origin: Ministère de la Santé et de la Protection Sociale, Kingdom of Morocco

title: Rotterdam tumour bank breast cancer cohort
abstract: Records of 2,982 women with primary breast cancer operated on between 1978 and 1993 whose tumour tissue was stored in the Rotterdam tumour bank, the Netherlands: age, menopausal status, tumour size, grade, nodes, hormone receptors, adjuvant treatment, and time to relapse and to death.
origin: Erasmus MC Cancer Institute (Daniel den Hoed Cancer Center), Rotterdam

title: Heart failure clinical records, Faisalabad
abstract: Clinical records and follow-up of 299 patients with left ventricular systolic dysfunction admitted to the Faisalabad Institute of Cardiology and the Allied Hospital, Faisalabad, Pakistan, in 2015, with time to death or censoring.
origin: Government College University and Faisalabad Institute of Cardiology

title: Colon cancer adjuvant chemotherapy trial
abstract: The Intergroup randomised trial led by the North Central Cancer Treatment Group and the Mayo Clinic: 929 patients with resected stage C colon cancer randomised to observation, levamisole, or levamisole plus fluorouracil, with tumour features and time to recurrence and to death.
origin: North Central Cancer Treatment Group and Mayo Clinic

title: Mayo Clinic primary biliary cholangitis trial
abstract: Patients with primary biliary cholangitis seen at the Mayo Clinic, 1974 to 1984: the 312 participants of the randomised trial of D-penicillamine versus placebo and 106 eligible patients who were followed but not randomised, with laboratory values and survival.
